description: Build integration audit module to verify permission_scope_enrichment is correctly wired to signal_analyser and output flows to mcp_signal_enrichments. Must query: (1) does signal_analyser import permission_scope_enrichment, (2) does it call compute_score and write to mcp_signal_enrichments with signal_type='permission_scope', (3) are there at least 100 rows in mcp_signal_enrichments WHERE signal_type='permission_scope'. Signal diagnostic shows 4 distinct values only — integration may be broken despite file existing. Pure diagnostic, no DB writes, reads source files and queries write_service only.
